description: This file contains a parser for RQL (Resource Query Language) predicates, implementing parsing rules for different query structures such as comparisons, logical operations, and existence checks, utilizing the parboiled2 parsing library.

classes.name: RqlPredicateParser
classes.description: A parser class for RQL predicates, extending RqlParserBase, providing parsing rules for different query types according to the RQL syntax.

methods.name: PredicateRoot
methods.description: Entry point for parsing an RQL predicate, returning the root node of the parsed AST.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Defines possible query structures: comparison, logical operations, or existence checks.

methods.name: SingleComparisonOp
methods.description: Parses a single comparison operation such as eq, ne, gt, etc., and returns a corresponding AST node.

methods.name: MultiLogicalOp
methods.description: Parses logical operations like 'and' and 'or' with multiple subqueries.

methods.name: SingleLogicalOp
methods.description: Parses a single logical operation like 'not'.

methods.name: ComparisonProperty
methods.description: Parses the property name in comparisons.

methods.name: ComparisonValue
methods.description: Parses the literal value in comparisons.
